{{Quote|So, you're my contact. Wes Durga, Republic scout.|Wes Durga|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Wes Durga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] scout in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he helped a Republic citizen rescue [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Otak'or Meln]] and Doctor [[Ortis]] from the [[Gorinth Brig]].
